resources.string: This App is written for people who live in pure anarchy, chaos and destruction! Without hope for a better life the only reason to exist any further is to find the path of shortest duration. It\'s not a sport, it\'s not a competition, it\'s an ancient urge that dates back to the old runes of Valhalla and the immortal souls existing there. Those souls spoke out of Fermat when he formulated his epic principle and those souls drive us in our quest to find: THE PATH OF SHORTEST DURATION!

Set up a new track: 
 1. Click the "set new track" button in the menu. 
 2. Touch and hold the marker B on the map to drag it onto the position where the FINISH tag is located. The button "update marker" moves the marker to the current position. 
 3. Scan the FINISH tag. 
 4. Touch and hold the marker A on the map to drag it onto the position where the START tag is located. 
 5. Fill in the track name and a short message/description/greeting/poem. 
 6. Scan the START tag and wait for the SUCCESS!!
